svg.aria-label: mille: the file tree for the editor you're building
svg.title: mille: the file tree for the editor you're building
svg.desc: mille's mark, a triangle above three dots, drawn as a construction. The triangle is labelled your folder. The three dots sit on one baseline: the left one is Rust, which walks and watches the folder; the right one is React, which draws the rows; TypeScript mirrors the tree in between.
